title: Define legal move selection and model failure behavior
source: The owner asked 'let's move to the next ticket' in the research child thread.
priorModelSelectionTicket: KHA-9 remains in progress; the mid-match compatibility-check question is unanswered.
terminalSummary:
Recorded: unfinished games can continue with a new model. Recorded losses stay final, with further play treated as practice.

I added [custom starting positions](https://linear.app/kamkm/issue/KHA-19/define-custom-starting-positions-and-position-editor) to the MVP plan.

Should players be able to **arrange pieces visually and paste a FEN position**? I recommend supporting both.
acceptedDecision: Do not supply a legal-move list or constrain the response to an enumeration of legal moves. The model proposes its own move and may receive corrections for mistakes.
acceptedDecisions: Do not supply a legal-move list or constrain the response to an enumeration of legal moves. The model proposes its own move and may receive corrections for mistakes.
Corrections explain the specific chess-rule violation without suggesting a replacement move or supplying the legal-move list. The model chooses its own replacement.
Allow three automatic correction retries after the initial illegal-move attempt, for four attempts total on the same turn. Exhaustion stops automatic retries and counts as a loss for the model.

After the model loss, offer optional continuation from the current position with the same model or a new model. Both continuation options use fresh context plus the current position. Ordinary mid-match switches retain the full prior conversation.
The original model loss remains final. Post-loss continuation is unscored practice with either the same model or a new model.
Provide the current position as both FEN and a readable list of pieces and their squares.
Return proposed moves in coordinate notation, including a promotion-piece suffix when needed.
Request a JSON object with a required move string and an optional plan string. A missing optional plan is not a failure, and separately returned reasoning remains in the conversation history.
Malformed replies, including invalid JSON or a missing move field, do not consume the four-attempt chess budget and cannot cause a chess loss.

Accept a clearly chosen coordinate move outside valid JSON after checking legality. Ask for formatting correction only when the chosen move is missing or ambiguous; do not infer a move from hypothetical plan alternatives.

Allow three separate formatting-correction retries per turn. They neither consume nor reset illegal chess-move attempts. Exhaustion pauses at the unchanged position with Retry or Switch model and no chess loss.

An explicit model refusal to make a move is resignation and a model loss. Do not use correction retries after this refusal. Resignation offers optional unscored practice continuation with the same or a new model, using fresh context and the current position. The loss remains final.
Any unfinished game can continue with a new model. Recorded losses remain final, and further play after a loss is practice. Lifecycle details remain in their own ticket.
Custom starting positions are included in MVP scope and specified in KHA-19.

acceptedRetryLimit.scope: Illegal chess-move correction only. Formatting failures are excluded. Explicit refusal to move is resignation. Transport failures and proxy-internal retries remain undecided.

acceptedExhaustionOutcome.result: Model loss after four illegal chess-move attempts on the same turn. Formatting failures do not trigger this loss.
acceptedExhaustionOutcome.continuation: Offer continuation from the current position with the same model or a new model.
acceptedExhaustionOutcome.relationshipToRecordedResult: The original model loss remains final. Continuation with the same or a new model is unscored practice and cannot erase or replace the loss.
acceptedExhaustionOutcome.ordinarySwitches: Retain the full prior match conversation.
acceptedExhaustionOutcome.transcriptRetention: Separate unresolved decision. Resetting the sent context does not decide deletion of stored transcripts.

acceptedBoardInput.scope: Ordinary play and post-loss practice, subject to the accepted conversation/reset rules.
acceptedBoardInput.guidance: Describe the position without legal-move lists or strategic advice.

acceptedMoveNotation.format: Starting square followed by destination, plus a promotion-piece suffix when needed.
acceptedMoveNotation.scope: Notation only. Detailed parsing and handling of malformed or ambiguous output remain undecided.

acceptedReplyFormat.reasoning: Preserve separately returned reasoning in conversation history.
acceptedReplyFormat.legalMoveEnumeration: Do not enumerate legal moves in the output schema.
acceptedReplyFormat.verification: Adapter-specific enforcement and concrete proxy request remain unverified.

acceptedFormattingFailures.reason: Response formatting is separate from chess-playing skill.
acceptedFormattingFailures.recovery: Accept clearly chosen coordinate moves after legality validation. Allow three separate formatting-correction retries per turn for missing or ambiguous moves, then pause without a loss.
acceptedFormattingFailures.recoveredIllegalMove: A clearly chosen illegal move still counts as a chess error, regardless of its response container.

acceptedParsingPolicy.fallback: Accept a clearly chosen coordinate move outside JSON after legality validation.
acceptedParsingPolicy.planAlternatives: Do not guess the chosen move from hypothetical alternatives in a plan.
acceptedParsingPolicy.illegalRecoveredMove: Counts as a chess error under the ordinary illegal-move budget.
acceptedParsingPolicy.remaining: Exact accepted fallback text patterns and player-triggered recovery behavior.

acceptedFormattingRetryLimit.chessAttemptInteraction: Formatting retries neither consume nor reset illegal chess-move attempts.
acceptedFormattingRetryLimit.exhaustion: Pause at the unchanged position with Retry or Switch model. No chess loss.
acceptedFormattingRetryLimit.remaining: Exact fallback text patterns and player-triggered recovery behavior.

acceptedRefusalOutcome.correctionRetries: Do not spend them trying to obtain a move after explicit refusal.
acceptedRefusalOutcome.distinctFrom: Provider errors, interrupted responses, and connection failures.
acceptedRefusalOutcome.remaining: Resignation response format and detection rules.
acceptedRefusalOutcome.practiceContinuation: Offer the same unscored practice continuation with the same or a new model, fresh context, and the current position. The original loss remains final.
